podcast.body: This was a record Chris Murphy played on with Blackpool. Despite his personal preference for hardcore at the time, he later regarded the roots rock album as "pretty cool." It was recorded live off the floor with producer Terry Brown, during which Murphy, playing bass, struggled with technique, prompting Brown to instruct him to stick to root notes ("footballs"). "Looking back now, I think actually the record that I played on was just called We The Living. It was actually pretty cool."
